cap: Sort third-trimester bleeding with three questions: is it painful, is the uterus tender, and whose blood is it? Previa bleeds painlessly from a placenta over the os; abruption hurts and can hide its blood behind the placenta; the accreta spectrum bleeds at delivery when the placenta will not separate; vasa previa loses fetal blood when the membranes rupture, so the fetal heart changes while the mother stays stable.
